Line.DefaultText: There you are! I'd have sworn we'd met before you ever walked in, word travels, and I already think of you as one of ours. Save the two of us the formal introductions, then: this inn is yours to use, meals and a bed both, the village's projects are open for the helping, and the Academy across the way will take you as a student any day you like. Ask around and settle in.

Answer.DefaultText: Good to finally meet you properly.
